messages.content: 尋找兩家電影院，位於聖地牙哥附近，提供下午5點的《天能》和晚上7點半的《007生死交戰》場次。

function.name: find_movie_showing
function.description: Find local movie theatres and their schedule for a specific movie Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. San Diego, CA

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find two movie theaters near San Diego that have showtimes: 5pm for "Tenet" (天能) and 7:30pm for "007生死交戰" (No Time To Die). We need to use the function find_movie_showing. The function expects location: string, movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[], time: string[]. So we need to call the function twice? Actually we need two theaters. We can call the function with location "San Diego, CA", movie "Tenet", time ["17:00"] to get theaters showing Tenet at 5pm. Then call with movie "No Time To Die", time ["19:30"] to get theaters showing that at 7:30pm. But the user wants two theaters that provide both showtimes? Or two separate theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, another for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. The phrasing: "尋找兩家電影院，位於聖地牙哥附近，提供下午5點的《天能》和晚上7點半的《007生死交戰》場次。" Means "Find two movie theaters near San Diego that offer a 5pm showing of Tenet and a 7:30pm showing of No Time To Die." It could mean find two theaters that each have those showtimes? Or find two theaters: one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. Likely the latter: find two theaters, one for Tenet at 5pm, one for No Time To Die at 7:30pm. So we need to call function twice.

We need to provide the function call. The function signature: find_movie_showing({location: string, movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[], time: string[]}). So we need to pass movie as array? It says movie: "Tenet" | "No Time To Die"[], so movie can be a string or array? The type is ambiguous. Probably we pass movie as string. Let's pass movie: "Tenet" and time: ["17:00"]. Then second call: movie: "No Time To Die", time: ["19:30"].

We need to output the function calls.
